mechanism: Ketorolac inhibits renal prostaglandin synthesis, reducing potassium excretion and increasing serum potassium levels, particularly in patients with renal impairment or those taking ACE inhibitors/ARBs.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; avoid concurrent use in patients with renal dysfunction, hyperkalemia risk, or those on ACE inhibitors; consider alternative NSAIDs or analgesics if potassium supplementation is necessary.
